title: Candidate original-language dictionary — all-language 20-shard reconstruction

method.historical_validation: Wiktionary inherited-from etymology links backtracked through the same grid when both forms have phonetics
method.execution: 20 concurrent reconstruction shards after one complete dictionary scan

research_boundary: These are model-derived candidate ancestral forms reconstructed from phonetic and semantic regularities across the scanned dictionary evidence. They are experimental reconstructions, not attested historical words, and phonetic fit alone cannot establish a single historical Proto-World language or override documentary chronology, morphology, borrowing evidence, archaeology, or established comparative sound laws.
